name: todo
summary: Deferred-work log: one entry per idea, recorded with restart context, then stopped
why: 'Note it and stop' has no moment an agent can recognise, while 'the user asked to defer this' arrives as text and matches a skill description. The boundary becomes an action with a visible result — and the measured failure it prevents looked like diligence: files cleaned up so a deferred gate would pass, twice.
gate: uv run .claude/skills/adr/scripts/generate-index.py docs/todo docs/todo/INDEX.md --prefix T- --label Todo --check
after: uv run .claude/skills/adr/scripts/generate-index.py docs/todo docs/todo/INDEX.md --prefix T- --label Todo
